source_text: Ingrediamur terram sanctam terminis virtutum servatis. Completur liber Numerorum Rufini XXVIII homiliis. Gloria Patri et Filio et Spiritui Sancto in saecula saeculorum. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Let-us-enter land holy with-boundaries of-virtues kept. Is-completed book of-Numbers of-Rufinus with-XXVIII homilies. Glory to-Father and Son and Spirit Holy into ages of-ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: Let us enter the holy land with virtue’s bounds kept. Rufinus’s twenty-eight Numbers homilies are complete. Glory to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit forever. Amen.
